messages:
carla: FYI customer ticket #5567 — tool call returning 400 schema error when args include pasted content from Windows editor.

support-bot: New ticket created: #5567 (severity: medium) :file_folder: 

leo: Can you paste the exact payload they sent or a minimal repro?

carla: Pasting the payload customer provided (redacted). Note: they pasted copied notes that likely had tabs.
```json
{"tool":"text_inspect","args":{"doc":"Title:\tProject notes
- item1\tTODO
"}}
```

ashley: I ran a quick parse against our local parser and got: "400 Bad Request - Unexpected control character at position 18". Seems the literal TAB (0x09) inside the JSON string is causing the parser to reject it.

leo: JSON strings must escape control chars (\u0009 or \t). Some clients (esp older SDKs or naive paste flows) send raw tabs. Do we have an SDK sanitizer that escapes control chars?

eng-runtime-bot: Note from runtime team: our strict parser (v0.8.x) rejects unescaped control characters per RFC4627. There was a relaxed mode in earlier versions but it was removed for security.

carla: Customer says they used the web UI copy/paste, not our SDK. They pasted from Notepad and hit send.

leo: Short repro curl I used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tool":"text_inspect","args":{"doc":"Title:\tNotes\tline2"}}'
```
This returns 400. If I change the body to escape the tab (\\t) it succeeds.

ashley: Confirmed. Working payload: 
```json
{"tool":"text_inspect","args":{"doc":"Title:\\tNotes\\tline2"}}
```

carla: Customer tried adding quotes around the string but that didn't help. They won't be able to manually escape tabs easily in the UI.

leo: Two remediation paths: (1) UX: HTML-escape/control-char-sanitize pasted input client-side before submit (recommended), (2) Support workaround: ask customer to export as .txt and upload via the file tool, or encode payload (base64) and pass as binary.

ashley: Is there a quick server-side mitigation? We could add a compatibility mode that replaces literal control characters in incoming JSON bodies, but that's risky. Would need product approval.

eng-runtime-bot: Runtime team prefers not to silently mutate JSON payloads. We can add a clear error message linking to docs that explain control char escaping and include sample fixes. Ticket: RUNTIME-3124 opened to add actionable error text.

carla: I gave the customer the temporary guidance (escape tabs or upload file). They asked for a permanent fix. I've escalated to product and eng with ticket #5567 and linked RUNTIME-3124.

leo: For support console note: workaround steps, repro curl, and attach the failing payload. Assign to eng-runtime if customer demands server-side compatibility.

carla: Thanks — closing the loop here. Will reply to customer and ping if they want eng escalation. :white_check_mark:
